scope: Independent verification using saved independently reconstructed per-run raw metrics. No original analyzer or simulator was imported or executed. Non-primary exported run metrics have independent aggregation/CI verification but are not all rederived from raw here.

statistical_method.independent_aggregation: 20-column frequency weights for each bootstrap sample; weighted mean; sorted bootstrap values and explicit linear interpolation at 0.025*(B-1),0.975*(B-1); point mean uses math.fsum/n
statistical_method.airtime_effect: Per-seed log(A_CPR/A_comparator), mean and percentile CI in log space, exponentiate point and bounds; not ratio of pooled means
statistical_method.undefined: Any undefined seed retains n=20 and forces all-seed mean/CI undefined, with undefined_n and identities retained
statistical_method.tolerance: Integer counts exact; finite numeric values within 1e-9 absolute + 1e-12 relative

provenance_review.created_at_semantics: Analysis start time, preceding internal audit completion; consistent with implementation.
limitations: Does not certify visual layout or manuscript interpretation.
No analyzer, simulation or new raw full audit was run.

undefined_observation_boundary: All 74 observed undefined summary rows have undefined_n=20. No zero-timely-delivery or nonpositive-airtime input occurs in the actual reviewed primary data; no partial-undefined stress test is claimed.
